name: Homework Simulator
author: Tornorr
description: Hit the corner of the pink orb at 29% and click at 30.1% to avoid an invisible hitbox, which lets you skip a speed portal. Play the next section normally and fall out of the level at 37%. Stay above the level until 63%, where you'll be teleported back into the level. Spam into the slope to get above the level (don't go too high or you'll die). Fall out of the level at 80%, free to the end from there.
